codelines.name: gotransit
codelines.reason: Implements the GO Transit checkout page's confirm-email validation, where the reported case-sensitive mismatch actually lives.
codelines.evidence: src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx:306 `validate: (value: string) => { if (email && value && value !== email) { return t("TRM774"); } }` — a raw case-sensitive `!==` comparison between the email and confirmEmail fields

facts.text: Tests run via `jest` (`npm test`), and the component under fix has an existing spec file at src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx to extend.

A pre-commit hook (husky) runs lint-staged and rejects the commit unless the current branch name matches ^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(/[a-z0-9-]+)?$, and a commit-msg hook runs commitlint on the message.
